name_zh: 泰戈尔：从诗性直觉到世界主义的『人文统一体』创造与跨文明对话范式
name_en: Tagore: From Poetic Intuition to Cosmopolitanism — the 'Human Unity' Creation and Cross-Civilizational Dialogue Paradigm
description_zh: 泰戈尔（Rabindranath Tagore，1861-1941）是印度孟加拉文艺复兴的核心人物、诗人、哲学家、音乐家与教育家。他是第一位获得诺贝尔文学奖（1913年，《吉檀迦利》）的亚洲人，其作品跨越诗歌、戏剧、小说、绘画与音乐多个领域。泰戈尔创立的「国际大学（Visva-Bharati）」位于桑提尼哥顿，倡导东西方文明的深层对话而非表面融合。他拒绝将印度文化封闭在民族主义框架内，而是通过诗性直觉（poetic intuition）构建「人文统一体」——在保持印度精神传统深度的同时，以开放姿态拥抱世界文明。泰戈尔对甘地式的民族主义保持批判距离，主张通过文化创造而非政治对抗实现印度复兴。他是Protreptic中模式17（多元思维模型法）在「跨文明深度对话」场景的独特样本，以及模式25（抽象归纳法）在「诗性知识体系化」场景的唯一完整代表。
description_en: Rabindranath Tagore (1861-1941) was the central figure of India's Bengali Renaissance — poet, philosopher, musician, and educator. He was the first Asian to receive the Nobel Prize in Literature (1913, Gitanjali), with works spanning poetry, drama, novels, painting, and music. His 'Visva-Bharati' (International University) in Santiniketan advocated deep dialogue between Eastern and Western civilizations rather than superficial fusion. He refused to enclose Indian culture within nationalist frameworks, instead constructing a 'human unity' through poetic intuition — maintaining the depth of Indian spiritual traditions while embracing world civilizations with openness. Tagore maintained critical distance from Gandhi-style nationalism, advocating Indian revival through cultural creation rather than political confrontation. He is the unique sample of mode 17 (Diverse Thinking Models) in 'cross-civilizational deep dialogue' and the only complete representative of mode 25 (Abstract Induction) in 'poetic knowledge systematization' within Protreptic.
reason_zh: 泰戈尔填补了Protreptic在「诗性智慧体系化」与「跨文明深度对话」两大领域的空白。他是模式17（多元思维模型法）在南亚文学-哲学传统中的唯一完整样本，展示了如何将诗歌、音乐、绘画等多艺术形式的直觉转化为可传承的认知框架；也是模式25（抽象归纳法）在「从诗性直觉到系统化教学」场景的唯一南亚代表。他对民族主义的独立批判立场，为Protreptic提供了「文化自主与开放对话的平衡」的经典案例。
reason_en: Tagore fills Protreptic's gaps in 'poetic wisdom systematization' and 'cross-civilizational deep dialogue'. He is the only complete sample of mode 17 (Diverse Thinking Models) in South Asian literary-philosophical tradition, demonstrating how intuitive knowledge from poetry, music, and painting can be transformed into inheritable cognitive frameworks; also the sole South Asian representative of mode 25 (Abstract Induction) in 'from poetic intuition to systematic teaching'. His independent critical stance on nationalism provides Protreptic with a classic case of 'balancing cultural autonomy and open dialogue'.
steps_zh: 第1步（模式25抽象归纳法）：诗性直觉的体系化——从个人诗歌创作（《吉檀迦利》《园丁集》）中抽象出「宇宙与个体灵魂融合」的核心命题，将印度吠檀多不二论传统转化为现代人可理解的情感-认知框架
第2步（模式17多元思维模型法）：跨学科知识整合——将诗歌、音乐（创作2000余首歌曲）、绘画（晚年突然开始绘画并被巴黎收藏）与哲学思考整合为统一的知识表达体系，以「艺术即认知」为核心方法论
第3步（模式9独立自主法）：文化自主与开放对话——拒绝将印度文化封闭在民族主义框架内，创立桑提尼哥顿学校（后发展为国际大学），以「世界即课堂」理念建立东西方平等对话机制，同时保持印度精神传统内核
第4步（模式31框架效应法）：对民族主义的独立批判——在甘地与英国殖民者之间保持第三条道路，以「民族主义是各国寻找黑暗的机制」重新框架民族认同问题，提出通过文化创造而非政治对抗实现复兴
第5步（范式固化）：人文统一体遗产——将「诗性直觉→多元整合→文化自主→独立批判」四环沉淀为跨文明对话的可操作范式，证明东方精神传统可以在保持深度的同时参与现代世界文明对话
steps_en: Step 1 (Mode 25 Abstract Induction): Systematizing poetic intuition — abstract the core proposition of 'fusion of cosmos and individual soul' from personal poetry (Gitanjali, Gardener's Collection), transforming Hindu Vedanta non-dualist tradition into emotionally-cognitively accessible frameworks for modern readers

Step 2 (Mode 17 Diverse Thinking Models): Cross-disciplinary knowledge integration — integrate poetry, music (composed 2000+ songs), painting (sudden late-life artistic burst collected in Paris), and philosophy into unified knowledge expression system, with 'art as cognition' as core methodology

Step 3 (Mode 9 Independence): Cultural autonomy and open dialogue — refuse to enclose Indian culture within nationalism, establish Santiniketan school (later Visva-Bharati), create East-West equal dialogue mechanism with 'world as classroom' concept while maintaining Indian spiritual tradition core

Step 4 (Mode 31 Framing Effect): Independent critique of nationalism — maintain third path between Gandhi and British colonizers, reframe national identity issues with 'nationalism is the mechanism nations use to find darkness', propose revival through cultural creation rather than political confrontation

Step 5 (Paradigm Solidification): Human unity legacy — condense 'poetic intuition→diverse integration→cultural autonomy→independent critique' into operable cross-civilizational dialogue paradigm, proving Eastern spiritual traditions can participate in modern world civilization dialogue while maintaining depth
expected_zh: 掌握泰戈尔从诗性创作到体系化思想的发展路径；理解桑提尼哥顿教育实验「世界即课堂」的理念结构及其东西方对话机制；评估泰戈尔对民族主义的独立批判在当代全球化和多元文化主义中的持续价值。
expected_en: Master Tagore's development path from poetic creation to systematic thought; understand Santiniketan educational experiment 'world as classroom' conceptual structure and its East-West dialogue mechanism; evaluate the continuing value of Tagore's independent critique of nationalism in contemporary globalization and multiculturalism.
case_zh: 1913年以英文诗集《吉檀迦利》获得诺贝尔文学奖，成为首位获此殊荣的亚洲人。他在桑提尼哥顿创立的学校不设围墙、以自然为课堂、邀请来自世界各地的学者与学生共学。他创作了印度国歌（《人民的意志》）和孟加拉国国歌，但拒绝支持甘地发起的「退出印度」运动，公开批评民族主义是「各国寻找黑暗的机制」。晚年他突然开始绘画，作品在巴黎、伦敦、纽约展出并被收藏。他的「国际大学」理念超越了东西方二元对立，建立了真正平等的跨文明对话空间，对当代全球化语境下的文化身份认同问题提供了经典解决方案。
case_en: Won the 1913 Nobel Prize in Literature for English poetry collection Gitanjali, becoming the first Asian to receive it. His Santiniketan school had no walls, used nature as classroom, and invited scholars and students from around the world to study together. He composed India's national anthem (Jana Gana Mana) and Bangladesh's national anthem, yet refused to support Gandhi's 'Quit India' movement, publicly criticizing nationalism as 'the mechanism nations use to find darkness'. In his late years he suddenly began painting, exhibited in Paris, London, and New York. His 'International University' concept transcended East-West binary opposition, establishing truly equal cross-civilizational dialogue space, providing a classic solution to cultural identity issues in contemporary globalization.
intellectual_tradition: Bengali Renaissance / Vedanta-influenced Humanism / Cosmopolitan Cultural Dialogue
cross_cultural_impact: First Asian Nobel Laureate in Literature; influenced global understanding of Indian spiritual philosophy; Visva-Bharati became model for cross-civilizational educational institutions; national anthems of India and Bangladesh
